title: LTB-CF2-INVENTORY-001: inventory manufacturing-output routes by implementation and authority
intent: On base 1ebc49610b1690ef7d761ab598758c5db8d6193c, record every mechanically discovered manufacturing-output candidate against its live route, implementation, carrier, authentication, and authority order. Do not change route behavior, qualify a generator, or contain a newly found route.

diff_articulation.what_changed: A CI-only inventory walks live routes, reconciles them with OpenAPI, and classifies manufacturing-output candidates by implementation, delegate, response carrier, and authority order. The declared JSON and Markdown are checked by the existing technical-debt job. P-2 and CF-4 proofs now share that walker and the program detector.
diff_articulation.why: Path tokens such as /gcode do not identify every emitter, and the historical 420-candidate audit is not in this repository. The post-CF-4 tree needed a source-level census before any further containment order.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: P-1 through CF-4 proved individual routes. They did not enumerate the rest of the manufacturing-output surface or keep that census from drifting.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No production router, readiness record, or manufacturing-output policy changed. P-1, P-2, P-3, and CF-4 refusals are unchanged. No generator was qualified. No discovered route was gated. No physical machine was driven.
diff_articulation.why_structural_extraction: The route walker and program detector moved into one CI module and a testkit so the inventory check does not import tests and the proofs do not keep a second walker.

commands_run: cd services/api && python3 -m app.ci.check_file_sizes --baseline app/ci/file_sizes_baseline.json && python3 -m app.ci.check_complexity --baseline app/ci/complexity_baseline.json && python3 -m app.ci.check_bare_except && python3 -m app.ci.check_duplication --threshold 100 && python3 -m app.ci.fence_checker_v2 && python3 -m app.ci.check_execution_class_compliance
proofs: OpenAPI and the recursive live walk reconcile. A direct-child walk is smaller. WebSockets, hidden routes, and framework paths are classified rather than treated as drift.
Every discovered candidate has a row. A stale or duplicate row fails the check. UNEXAMINED notes do not call a route safe.
NeckPipeline, NeckGCodeGenerator, the inline guitar neck, Flying V pocket_generator, retract aliases, polygon, geometry export, and the five probe tool ids keep the authority keys already proved.
Draft polygon, geometry, and probe routes remain LIVE_UNGOVERNED. The inventory does not permit them.
verification.hardware: No physical-machine execution. No generated program was sent to a machine.
